== instructions
Mode: none - nothing is changed on vps.example.com.

The server will listen on 0.0.0.0:8080 and forward connections to 127.0.0.1:3000 as reached from this PC.

Warning: bind address 0.0.0.0 needs "GatewayPorts clientspecified" on the server. With the default (GatewayPorts no) sshd binds to 127.0.0.1 only. Switch to mode "sshd" to generate that setup.

Requirements: user "tunnel" can log in with the configured key authentication and AllowTcpForwarding is not disabled for it.
